# `parameter-renamed`

Parameter renamed (detected)

| | |
|---|---|
| **Kind** | `sdk` |
| **Default severity** | `info` · `--profile sdk`: `error` |
| **Rule IDs** | `parameter-renamed` (all locations), `query-parameter-renamed`, `header-parameter-renamed`, `cookie-parameter-renamed`. Path parameters use `parameter-renamed`. |
| **Status** | Planned (M8) |
| **Group** | Parameters ([RULES.md section 4](../../RULES.md)) |

## What it detects

A parameter appears to have been renamed: same position and schema, different name.

## Why this default

On the wire, old clients send the old name, which is also reported as removed + added. In generated SDKs, the method's argument name changes.

## Example

_No example yet: one is added with the rule's test case when the rule is implemented._

## Policy options

Every rule takes `severity` (`error`, `warn`, `info` or `off`), `fix` and `explanation` in the policy file, for the generic ID or any variant ID above (the more specific ID wins). The policy file arrives in M6; see [POLICY.md](../../POLICY.md).

```yaml
rules:
  parameter-renamed: info
```

## How to fix

Keep the old name, or accept both names during a transition.
